result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the food delivery app page: one truncated restaurant card and one partially visible category filter button.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off on the right edge, truncating both the image and the restaurant name text.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll list has proper padding/snapping and that partially visible cards are clearly indicated as scrollable, or adjust card sizing so the truncation is intentional and the name is not cut mid-word.

issues.description: The last category filter pill in the horizontal filter row (after 'Healthy') is partially visible and cut off, with no visual affordance indicating the list is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade gradient or arrow indicator at the right edge of the filter row to signal that more categories are available via horizontal scrolling.
